name: Lolicon Otoko to Danchikko ~Ue no Kai ni Sumu Shoujo o Heya ni Tsurekonde Ecchi na Itazura~
original_name: ロリコン男と団地っ娘～上の階に住む少女を部屋に連れ込んでエッチな悪戯～
source:
"Natsuko Takamura" was her name.
She was always loitering by herself by the steps of the building where we both lived.
She seemed not to be good at making friends. I could relate.

"Maybe I can be friends with you, mister."

The words were like magic. Natsuko and I were friends now,
just by her arbitrary and naive choice. So simple. It's why I like young girls.
I invited her into my place to hang out for a while.

To enjoy some grown up friendship.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE131399.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
她的名字是“高村夏子”。
她总是一个人在我们住的大楼的台阶上闲逛。
她看起来不太擅长交朋友。我可以理解。

“也许我可以和你做朋友，先生。”

这些话就像魔法一样。我和夏子现在是朋友了
只是她武断而天真的选择。就这么简单。这就是为什么我喜欢年轻女孩。
我邀请她到我家去玩一会儿。

享受一些成熟的友谊。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE131399.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
